# Google Ads

Advertising · options checked 2026-10-21 · [how sources are chosen](../../docs/SOURCING.md)

**Google publishes its own tools for AI agents. Start with those.**

No skills, but Google publishes an official read-only MCP server for the Google Ads API (googleads/google-ads-mcp), indexed as google-ads-mcp. It adds a usage-data header to API calls.

## What to use

### From Google

- **[Google Ads MCP Server](../../skills/google-ads-mcp/README.md)** — MCP server · Only reads; changes nothing; sends usage data to its publisher · needs Google Ads developer token and OAuth credentials · [source](https://github.com/googleads/google-ads-mcp/tree/main)
  Google's official MCP server for the Google Ads API: query campaigns, spend and performance with Google Ads Query Language, read resource metadata, and list accessible accounts.

## Mosofin connection status

How far Mosofin's own connector to this platform has got. This is separate from the tools above.

| | |
|---|---|
| Status | roadmap — Committed — registration runbook written |

| Token | 1 h access; refresh non-expiring once published |
| Lead time | Explorer often instant; Basic ~5 days |

**What to watch:** Explorer tier covers production accounts with no review, so this need not block on approval. While the consent screen is in Testing, refresh tokens expire after 7 days — publish before debugging. Separate Cloud projects for dev and prod are Google policy, not preference.
